About Podium Watch

Built for Ohio runners.

Podium Watch covers Ohio high school cross country and track and field through rankings, stories, interviews, and meet coverage. The goal is to give athletes, teams, coaches, families, and fans one place to follow the sport and celebrate the people who make it special.
